# StorageApp-Frontend instructions

- Before any UI/UX work, read [`../UI_UX_GUIDE.md`](../UI_UX_GUIDE.md). It is the
  visual source of truth across all pages and shared components.
- For visual-only work, preserve existing behavior and do not change application
  logic, APIs, data flow, routing, authentication, subscriptions, uploads,
  sharing, permissions, or state transitions.
- Reuse shared design tokens and component patterns; do not create page-specific
  themes or separate modal/toast styles.
- Keep changes responsive and keyboard-accessible, verify contrast, and respect
  reduced-motion preferences.
- Use the installed `ui-ux-pro-max` skill when available. The project guide and
  the user's request take precedence over generated recommendations.
